reviews.author: zinny eme
reviews.text:
I’ve been a loyal customer of Helen Beauty Salon in Al Nahda, Sharjah, for quite some time now, and I can't recommend it enough! Every visit is a pleasant experience. The salon offers excellent services for hair, spa and nails, and I always leave feeling pampered and refreshed.
A special mention goes to the manager, Ms. Helen—she’s not only incredibly skilled but also kind-hearted and truly cares about her clients. She always ensures that I’m comfortable and satisfied with the results. Her warm and welcoming personality makes each visit feel more like a visit to a friend’s place than just another appointment.
The team is professional, and the salon itself is always clean and well-maintained. If you're looking for a place to relax, get top-notch beauty treatments, and be treated with kindness, Helen Beauty Salon is the place to go!
Thank you, Ms. Helen and team, for always making my experience so special!

reviews.author: Iddy M
reviews.text:
The ladies were polite, but the lack of transparency is unacceptable. There is no list of services or prices—everything seems to be decided on the spot and kept in the hairdressers’ heads. I was charged 100 dhs for a so-called deep conditioning treatment with Ethiopian butter, followed by one of the worst blow-dries I’ve ever had. I genuinely left looking worse than when I walked in.

The young girl who did the blow-dry was clearly very inexperienced, and it showed. The process was rough, poorly done, and left my hair looking sad, frizzy, and neglected rather than styled. After the wash—which was already quite harsh (understandable as I had just taken my braids down)—I asked for a roll set instead of a blow-dry. I was told this would cost extra, despite there being absolutely no pricing listed anywhere in the salon or online.

To make matters worse, I was asked to pay by card before receiving any service. The braiders appeared far more experienced (worth noting), but as a first-time client, this visit was extremely disappointing and left me very dissatisfied.
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you 🙏
